source.scope: GLIF trained checkpoint is a gated learned-LIF variant, not a vanilla LIF or FireFly reproduction.

full_test.scope: Full public floating-point model accuracy in local CPU runtime; original reference reproduction gate. No integer SNN, exact packing hardware accuracy, speedup or FireFly replication claim.

original_pilot.model: Official GLIF ResNet18 CIFAR10 T2 CW
original_pilot.scope: Float inference with bit-identical observation of its existing U+I component. Unit sweeps are rounded observed-operand screens, not integer inference, safe width certificates, RTL replay, quantization accuracy or FireFly replication.

operand_screen.conclusion: No predeclared unit establishes a hardware advantage. At coarse unit16 all observed membranes and currents fit int8; at finer units current exceptions invalidate existing I8-only RTL. In all68 layer/unit observed-width pairs, membrane-only narrowing with a global current width saves no high-base metadata. Joint U/I or sum admission is a different implementation that would need fair fixed controls and its own proof/RTL.
limits: Observed maxima are not legal width certificates.
Rounded float operands do not constitute integer SNN inference or preserved float outputs.
Pilot accuracy is not a reproduction of full published94.19percent accuracy.
No prospective workload can reduce the request count below a legal eight-output fixed baseline for this addition interface.

real_arithmetic_envelope_screen.scope: Real-valued affine/convolution envelopes for all allowed input pixels and binary intermediate spikes, plus correlated previous-spike GLIF bounds atT2. Separate states and currents covered. Not a certified IEEE32 bound, integer neuron equation, RTL width certificate or accuracy-preserving quantization. No additional numerical model is executed.

coefficient_scope_screen.conclusion: The old coefficient231/delta25 near-identity leakage candidate does not directly cover these learned GLIF coefficients. Do not set the model coefficient to231 to make the hardware fit. General narrow3/fixed/split arithmetic experiments are separate retained controls.
coefficient_scope_screen.scope: Real learned coefficient inspection and illustrative nearest-Q8 compatibility only. No Q8 model was executed, no accuracy-preserving quantization, natural decoder cost or new packing benefit is established.

rejected_preview_pilot.old_float_observer_arithmetic_results_sc: Lossy viewer images only; not original CIFAR10 benchmark or hardware evidence.

paper_readiness: Current adaptive addition core has no demonstrated advantage over the strongest exact fixed native hybrid. This broader public model stage does not reverse that result.
next_gate: Declare and validate an application-backed integer LIF leakage operation/coefficients, then test the existing and new exact mechanisms against strongest fixed DSP/LUT controls before another hardware trial.
